name: v2-dwell-and-sync
review: Each 10 mm axis move at 80 steps/mm gives 800 steps; the directions and final position (0, 800, 0) follow the G-code. Each move begins and ends at zero speed, so a continuous triangular profile with 100 mm/s^2 acceleration takes 2*sqrt(10/100) = 0.632456 s; the recorded 0.62968 s differs by 0.44%, within the trace checker's 0.5% timing tolerance. At 10 us/tick, the gaps between recorded block end and next start are 50.32 ms and 1000.32 ms versus commanded 50 ms and 1 s. This analytical approximation does not independently verify the discrete stepping algorithm or physical hardware; two simulator runs produced identical traces.
